ahead: The review found no defect in any of the five items of ARC_SPLIT_BUDGET.md; the arc-split constant 2 gamma/3 stands, along with the recomputed true optimum gamma/43 of the previous budget (versus its stated gamma/240). One sub-step (the m>sqrt N denominator range's auxiliary sieve-tail lemma, and the linear-piece constants generally in section 4.1) was checked only at the order-of-magnitude/structural level, not re-derived symbol by symbol; it is not the binding term in any budget, so this does not threaten the conclusion, but a future check could redo it in full if section 4.1 is ever load-bearing elsewhere.

work.what: In hunts/prime_pair_error/ARC_SPLIT_BUDGET.md section 4.1 ('The linear pieces'), fully re-derive the three denominator-range bounds for the linear part of the correction polynomial C_N(h) (the terms involving u_q(h)J_1(h)+v_q(h)J_2(h) via the Gauss-sum expansion chi(h)tau(chibar)=sum_a chibar(a)e(ah/q)), matching each constant the way the quadratic piece was matched in ARC_SPLIT_BUDGET_REVIEW.md item 4. Also independently re-derive the auxiliary estimate used in the m>sqrt N range, sum_{m>X, g|m} phi(m)^{-2} << g phi(g)^{-2} X^{-1} ell^{O(1)}, from first principles (not by citation), and confirm it feeds into a coefficient bound of order N q tau(h) ell^{O(1)} / sqrt N as claimed. Report whether the claimed final orders N^3 ell^{O(1)}/R^2 (for R<qd<=sqrt N), N^{2+o(1)} (for qd>sqrt N), and N^3 ell^{O(1)}/R (for qd<=R) survive exactly, and whether any constant or power of ell differs from what is stated. This term is not currently binding in any budget, so treat this as a completeness check rather than an urgent one.
